strings.text: The garages behind the nine-storey block, ten to three.
strings.translation: Los garajes detrás del edificio de nueve plantas, las tres menos diez.

strings.text: The lamp by the garages has been blinking since winter.
strings.translation: La farola de los garajes lleva parpadeando desde el invierno.

strings.text: Shnyr cracks his seeds and doesn't look to the right.
strings.translation: Shnyr come pipas y no mira a la derecha.

strings.text: There are three of them. Four are squatting.
strings.translation: Son tres. En cuclillas hay cuatro.

strings.text: The fourth one has squatted down right next to them, in the very light, and silently holds out his hand: got a smoke?
strings.translation: El cuarto se ha agachado pegado a ellos, en plena luz, y en silencio tiende la mano: ¿tienes un cigarro?

strings.text: The door of the third garage creaks ajar. Nobody comes out.
strings.translation: La puerta del tercer garaje se entreabre con un chirrido. No sale nadie.

strings.text: While the lamp was blinking, the fourth one got a step closer.
strings.translation: Mientras la farola parpadeaba, el cuarto se ha acercado un paso.

strings.text: Shnyr has run out of seeds.
strings.translation: A Shnyr se le han acabado las pipas.
